{
  "implementation": "def solve(case):
    round_scores = case['round_scores']
    round_targets = case['round_targets']
    forced = case.get('forced', [])
    forced_set = set(forced)
    n_rounds = len(round_scores)
    n_items = len(round_scores[0])
    current_indices = list(range(n_items))
    history = []
    for r in range(n_rounds):
        target = round_targets[r]
        scores = round_scores[r]
        current_forced = [i for i in current_indices if i in forced_set]
        non_forced = [i for i in current_indices if i not in forced_set]
        selected = list(current_forced)
        remaining = target - len(selected)
        if remaining > 0:
            non_forced_sorted = sorted(non_forced, key=lambda i: scores[i], reverse=True)
            selected.extend(non_forced_sorted[:remaining])
        elif remaining < 0:
            selected = sorted(current_forced, key=lambda i: scores[i], reverse=True)[:target]
        selected_sorted = sorted(selected, key=lambda i: scores[i], reverse=True)
        history.append(selected_sorted)
        current_indices = selected
    last_scores = round_scores[-1]
    retained_indices = sorted(current_indices, key=lambda i: last_scores[i], reverse=True)
    return {
        "history": history,
        "retained_indices": retained_indices
    }"
}
